Shared-memory layout and initialization for the transaction cache, with size checks and join.

# Purpose
This file defines the shared-memory setup code for the transaction cache in `fd_txncache`. It provides the size and alignment queries [`fd_txncache_shmem_align`](<#fd_txncache_shmem_align>) and [`fd_txncache_shmem_footprint`](<#fd_txncache_shmem_footprint>), plus the constructor and attach functions [`fd_txncache_shmem_new`](<#fd_txncache_shmem_new>) and [`fd_txncache_shmem_join`](<#fd_txncache_shmem_join>). The code computes the memory needed from `max_live_slots` and `max_txn_per_slot`, checks for overflow, and lays out the shared-memory region with the cache control block, a blockhash map, a pool of blockcache entries, per-slot page and head arrays, per-slot `descends` sets, and the free list for transaction pages.

The file also defines the internal container types used by the shared-memory cache: `blockcache_pool`, `blockhash_map`, and `root_slist`. These are built from template source files in `../../util/tmpl/` and are used to manage cache entries, map blockhash values to cache entries, and track root entries. The [`fd_txncache_shmem_new`](<#fd_txncache_shmem_new>) function initializes all of these structures, sets cache limits, fills the free page list, and writes the magic value used by [`fd_txncache_shmem_join`](<#fd_txncache_shmem_join>) to validate an attached region.
